description: This file defines a React functional component named WorkspaceSwitcherMenu, which renders a menu for switching between different workspaces. It manages application descriptors, handles sign-out, activation, and creation of workspaces, and displays menu items accordingly.

classes.name: WorkspaceSwitcherMenu
classes.description: A React functional component that provides a menu interface for switching, adding, and signing out of workspaces.

methods.name: signoutAll
methods.description: Prompts user for confirmation and signs out of all workspaces if confirmed.

methods.name: destroyWorkspace
methods.description: Sets the signing-out state in the account menu controller, indicating a workspace is being destroyed or signed out.

methods.name: activateWorkspace
methods.description: Unloads current workspace and activates the selected workspace descriptor.

methods.name: addAnotherWorkspace
methods.description: Unloads the current workspace and creates a new workspace descriptor.
